waveContract.pauseScheduling: Valid scaled active time only; capped .1s scheduler step, at most one activation/update, no hitch catch-up. Full run clock retains valid delta.
waveContract.legacyProfiles: useRhythmicWaves defaultsfalse, preserving previous fixed quota/interval/cap and standard-only actors.
waveContract.variants: Wave1 standard only; wave2 introduces runners; wave3 introduces heavy units. Composition keyed to wave-local activation ordinal, not slot.
waveContract.runIdentity: Guid N allocated once per successful BeginRun. Immutable LastRunSummary survives selection/retry; ResultRevision advances exactly once per terminal result.
waveContract.settlementObservation: A retry clears HasRunSummary but retains latest completed snapshot/revision for pending settlement polling; progression owns persisted deduplication.
waveContract.rescueEligibility: Rescued=1 only after recruited ally and hero actually reach extraction; exhausting supply alone never wins.
waveContract.profilerScope: Static AutoScopes enabled only in Editor or Development Build; actual captures require native Unity execution.

crowdContract.scope: Measured kinematic stress scenarios without PhysX pushes. Authored obstacle routing is checked using deterministic segment results.
crowdContract.approach: Target-specific stable lanes; a stable outer orbit for far-side positions; avoidance of neighbors with any target; two radial half-plane projection passes followed by exact final-step swept-circle clipping. Navigation rejects blocked final motion.
crowdContract.reuse: Disable, death, target change, emergence and reset release the lane/orbit. Pooled visuals/materials are reused. Variant tint preserves alpha and unrelated property overrides. Uniform scale is included in the distance-based walk cadence.
